newsitem.title: USA: CME deferred hogs jump limit up, pork bellies gain.
newsitem.headline: CME deferred hogs jump limit up, pork bellies gain.

text.p: CME August and October lean hogs briefly posted limit gains of two cents per lb in early trading, and slipped back to trade sharply higher, with support linked to USDA's report Thursday, which showed fewer hogs later this year than analysts expected, traders said.
Pork bellies sped sharply higher in reaction to the USDA report.
At 0915 CST, hog futures were off 0.125 to up 1.700 cent with April off 0.075 at 72.400. Pork bellies were up 2.100 to 2.025 cent with May up 2.025 at 77.150.
